pages.text: The morning bread was all baked. The display shelf was still empty.
Today Coco would fill the shelf. Round bread below, long bread above.
Mrs. Magpie looked through the window. "The shiny ones belong in front!"
She put all the sugared bread in the front row. Sparkle, sparkle.
Then she put buttered bread in front of that. Shine, shine.
The display became a jumble. Long bread lay on round bread, with more bread on top.
Jingle! The door opened, then closed again. A customer shook their head and left.
Coco started all over. Round bread with round bread, long bread with long bread.
Jingle! The door opened again. "Wow! It's easy to choose!"
The customer chose one round loaf. Mrs. Magpie couldn't take her eyes off the sugared bread. Sparkle, sparkle.
